extra.reason: Landed as a memoizing TermCache on Store. Measured ~3.9-4.9x on the 2-hop join, ~1.4x on the type scan, ingest unchanged. Follow-up quipu-h03 filed for the unbounded growth.

Landed as TWO features rather than one: 'remote' (ureq, the federation client) and 'server' (axum/tower-http/tokio, implying remote). Verified cargo tree --no-default-features has no axum/tower-http/tokio/ureq/mio/hyper. The wasm build now gets past mio and stops at getrandom (quipu-gsg). CI matrix gained a 'remote' entry in both clippy and test.

Rewritten as a ratchet. .file-size-baseline grandfathers the 23 existing violators at their current size; they may shrink, growing fails. New violations fail outright. pre-commit runs --staged (quiet, sufficient — growth only arrives via staged changes); CI runs the authoritative full scan plus scripts/test-check-file-size.sh, 7 tests covering the behaviours including that --update-baseline never loosens.

src/store/read_model.rs: three permutation indexes over one graph's current facts, Store::build_read_model(graph), apply/apply_all for incremental maintenance. 12 tests, load-bearing ones differential. Deliberately inert — nothing consults it, and it is not stored on Store, because residency and invalidation belong with the scope guard (quipu-syt). Measured: 246ms build / 55.5MB / 0.259ms 2-hop join at 10k episodes, FASTER and smaller than the prototype because the term dictionary now lives on Store from quipu-yzf.

Bounded at DEFAULT_TERM_CACHE_LIMIT (500k terms, ~175MB at the measured 350 bytes/term), adjustable via Store::set_term_cache_limit; 0 disables caching and drops what is held. At the cap it refuses admission rather than evicting — every policy is correct since a miss reads SQL, and eviction under a full-dictionary scan just thrashes. 3 tests including that warm_term_cache respects the cap.
